batting.dismissal: c RP Singh b RJ Peterson

batting.name: AC Blizzard
batting.dismissal: c DPMD Jayawardene b IK Pathan

batting.dismissal: c KP Pietersen b M Morkel

balls.text: would you believe it? The last ball is a dot ball. In the blockhole outside off stump and KP gets beaten as he tries to squeeze through point
a full toss and Ojha mis-times the pull towards deep midwicket ... it falls short of the fielder
full ball outside off, KP drives to long off to bring up a 50 off 25 balls

short of a length ball angled across the right-hander, Ojha steers off the back foot and beats Malinga at short third man, KP runs very hard once the ball passes the fielder and he comes back for the third
clears his front foot and powers the full ball to long-on, only a single though
the first ball is a low full toss outside off stump, KP drives the power from his crease and finds the extra cover boundary
another yorker, KP makes a bit of room to push the ball towards cover
well he had to defend that, it was a yorker on off and middle stump
shorter length outside off stump, steered to third man
a third yorker, but the batsman is good enough to keep it out

another lbw! Malinga fires in a fast yorker, Nagar tried to play towards midwicket and missed, that was swinging into him as it thudded into the pad and might have missed leg stump. The umpire did not think so. Malinga's on a hat-trick
lbw! Malinga bowled a straight full toss, Taylor missed the pull across the line and was hit on the thigh. That was dipping, though, and if there's no inside edge that is plumb
KP's edged this one past the keeper and to the third man boundary, he was looking to drive the ball. 20 runs off the run and Peterson's figures have been destroyed

this time he misses the switch-hit after lunging on the front foot, his back foot is out of his crease as he loses balance a little, has he got it back in time before Karthik broke the stumps? It's very close. He  got a tiny fraction of his back shoe behind the line, close call for KP but he survives
KP shows Peterson the original switch-hit, getting into position early and pulling it over the cover boundary, that cleared the rope very easily
that's hit the middle, and flown over the long-on boundary. KP came forward, cleared his front foot and slammed the ball straight
KP goes after the left-arm spinner and lifts the ball into the gap between long-on and deep midwicket, he connected with the bottom of the bat
a long hop, and Taylor's terrific at smashing long hops for six. He swivels and pulls the ball high and far over deep backward square leg, into the stands
chipped off the back foot over cover, there's a fielder in the deep
that's blitzed hard and straight, a hazard for the bowler and umpire. KP drove that with tremendous power, long-off had no chance
quick again, from over the wicket, Taylor flicks the ball off his pads along the ground to deep square leg
he's not missed this! Taylor came forward to a quicker ball and slammed it flat over deep square leg
Taylor tries to slog towards deep square leg but misses the ball delivered from round the wicket, that was a slow ball
driven towards long on, Peterson's conceded only 17 in three overs so far. That's gold for Mumbai. He's taken all three wickets too, where's he been all this while
nudged off the back foot behind square
driven on the front foot through midwicket

he's been caught first ball! Peterson might keep Delhi below 200 yet! Irfan comes out of his crease, Peterson bowls the ball wide, Irfan reaches for it and slogs straight, lofting the ball very high. When it came down, Thisara Perera was under it at long-on. He's on the field for Pollard
KP backs away to dab the ball towards cover

caught at deep cover! Sehwag made room by moving towards leg and wanted to hit over extra cover, he ended up slicing it high over cover, RP Singh came running in from the boundary and took the catch on the move. He looked a bit jittery while taking it but held on in the end.
too full angling into the right-hander, KP flicks the ball in the air over the fielder at midwicket and into the gap on the boundary
doesn't matter, the long-off fielder simply watches the ball sail over his head. KP cleared his front foot and lofted the ball inside out and all the way
KP backs away to create room and launches a length ball over the fielder in the circle at mid-off
what happened there? That would have been a wide had the batsman been a left-hander. It was that far down leg.
Sehwag stays on the back foot and square drives the ball in front of point
nearly in the blockhole that was, Pietersen flicks the ball towards fine leg
full ball on middle and leg, Pietersen clips it towards midwicket, doesn't beat the fielder
nearly a wicket maiden, but the fielder at midwicket couldn't cut off the back foot punch towards wide long-on. Peterson has given Delhi a good over after ages
played back to the bowler from the crease again
Pietersen tries to punch through cover but is cramped for room
tries to nudge the ball on the leg side but it hits the pad
driven back to the bowler
spoke too soon, Mahela's reverse pulled Peterson to point, he hit it straight to the fielder, Rohit Sharma did not need to move. I wonder if Peterson will show Mahela how it's done later tonight
a yorker, and Mahela manages to steer it towards third man. The ploy of bringing back Malinga has failed. What will Mumbai do now?
Mahela gets down on one knee and slogs a slower ball from outside off stump to the midwicket boundary, one-bounce four
a full ball down leg side, Sehwag misses the flick and Karthik fails to collect cleanly again, I thought the ball had hit something but the umpire did not
Mahela gets to his fifty with an awkward shot. He played the pull too early against a slower ball and the ball hit the back of the bat and fell on the off side

he's done it again, but this time Pollard has hurt himself as he landed. Looks like a shoulder problem. Mahela cut the ball high over point and up Pollard went, his arm outstretched over his head to get fingertips on the ball and slow it down. The physio's out on the field taking a look. Pollard is now walking off the field clutching his shoulder, his right shoulder
Sehwag cut the short and wide ball hard and high over point, not high enough though, because Pollard took off, leaping high into the air to get one hand on the ball, tremendous effort
that's short of a length but much too wide outside off, Sehwag reached out to cut the ball but it was too far away
a low full toss on middle and leg, Mahela glances off his pads to the fine leg boundary where Peterson covers good ground and dives to his right to save the four
width outside off stump, Sehwag makes some room as well and has plenty of time to cut the ball into the gap on the backward point boundary
Sehwag makes room by moving towards leg and biffs the ball in the air towards long-off, Rohit Sharma runs to his right to field and almost makes a mess of it
slightly short on middle stump, Mahela pulls towards wide long on

Mahela steps out of his crease and drives the ball towards cover through he wasn't to the pitch of it, Sehwag had set off for the single but was sent back, he turned around quickly and stretched to regain ground before Harbhajan took off the bails
Mahela backs away to try and cut a quicker ball but gets beaten
Mahela brings out the reverse swat and beats the fielder at short third man, the boundaries are coming thick and fast, as the cliche goes
shocking over from Mumbai's KP, a short ball on leg stump, Sehwag stays in his crease, swivels and pulls to the long leg boundary
tremendous hitting from the local favourite. Sehwag launches a length ball over the cow corner boundary with a powerful swing of the bat. It was the slower ball but it did not matter
a full toss on leg stump, you and I might have been able to take some runs of that. Sehwag simply clips it off his pads to the fine leg boundary, the fielder was in the circle
the slower ball on middle stump, Mahela uses the angle into him from over the wicket to glance towards fine leg
flicked off the pads behind square

short ball and Sehwag has dismissed it with a powerful pull, heaving it high into the night sky, it lands in the stands. That shot has brought up his fifty and the Kotla crowd are cheering themselves hoarse.
short of a length ball down leg side, Sehwag tries to pull but it's too far away
pulled off the back foot towards wide long-on, not timed very well, Pollard runs to his right from long-on and fields
driven from the crease through point
Sehwag moves back but can't force the ball past midwicket
driven off the back foot towards wide long-on
Mahela late cuts from close to off stump, Malinga dives to his left at short third man and makes a half stop
Mahela steps out of his crease, is beaten by the flight, and lets the ball hit his body in the end
Mahela opens the face of the bat late to dab the ball from off stump to short third man
short ball, and Mahela pulls the ball into the gap on the midwicket boundary. Precise placement.
played towards point once again
hit off the back foot through point, Sehwag had to reach for that
Karthik's missed a stumping! Sehwag charged Peterson very early and swung hard, he missed. The ball thudded into Karthik's pads and the keeper reacts in despair. Sehwag was miles out of his crease
Sehwag greets him by moving his front foot towards leg and clobbering the ball over the long-on boundary, that's in the stands
this time RP Singh does stop the ball, it was hit straight to him by Sehwag
Sehwag flat-bats the ball past the bowler towards long-off, RP Singh runs to his right, gets to the ball, gets hand on it but can't prevent the boundary, shoddy effort
played off the back foot to the off side
Sehwag wanted to hit that hard but ended up playing back to the bowler
Mahela plays the reverse paddle, hitting the ball in the air just short of Malinga at short third man, the fielder fumbles to allow the single
cut off the back foot behind point
Sehwag tries to whip off his pads but misses, they get a leg bye on the leg side
Sehwag backs away and plays a short of a length ball towards point, he runs the single and a poor throw to the bowler allows an overthrow
Sehwag backed away towards leg to make room, Shukla followed him with a full ball, Sehwag flicked the ball in the air to the deep midwicket boundary, one-bounce four
Pollard leaps to his right at point to take the pace of Mahela's fierce cut, saved three runs
good length and straight, Sehwag stays on the back foot and tucks the ball behind square leg
Sehwag stays in his crease and tries to steer a short of a length ball behind point, that was close to off stump and beat the bat
good length on middle to end the over, Mahela defends
a slower ball, but it's down leg side
that's the first six of the night! Sehwag simply flat-bats a short ball over long-off, RP Singh has a glum look on his face
short of a length with width outside off, Sehwag stays back and flays the ball over point, hitting it extremely hard
fuller length on leg and middle, Mahela flicks from his crease to deep square leg
Mahela backs away and tries to cut the ball as it angles across him from over the wicket, the ball is slow off the pitch and once again the batsman makes no contact
RP Singh goes leg stump to Sehwag again, this time the fielder at short fine leg manages to dive to his right and cut off Sehwag's glance, that came off the pad actually
skiddy, fuller ball outside off stump, Mahela cuts from his crease but is beaten once again
short of a length outside off stump, Mahela tries to steer to third man but gets beaten by the bounce
now he steps out towards the bowler and tries to hit through cover, doesn't find the gap
too full on leg stump, Mahela stays balanced in his crease and flicks the ball firmly to the backward square leg boundary
that's too full and too close to off stump to play the cut, Sehwag plays it anyway, he has no room and bottom edges the ball into the ground behind point
Mahela stays in his crease and opens the face of the bat late to steer a short of a length ball to third man
leg-stump line and RP Singh pays for it, Sehwag stays on the back foot and glances the ball off his pads, too fine for the fielder at short fine leg
good length just outside off, Mahela opens the face to guide the ball to third man
too full outside off stump, Mahela stays in his crease, waits for the ball, and then drills it wide of mid-off with a graceful drive
Mahela moves forward and across to try and swat the ball against the angle across him from over the wicket, he misses
short of a length and straight, Sehwag pulls in front of square

good length and straight, Mahela drops the ball close on the off side and runs, RP Singh runs towards the ball and Sehwag finds his route blocked, after a moment or two, he finds a way around and completes the single without any hassles
a straight yorker, Mahela deals with it by staying in his crease and clipping through midwicket
there's no stopping this four, Mahela uses the short length and width outside off stump to cut the ball through the gap at point. Mahela's laid into Malinga this over
good length with width outside off stump, Mahela steers towards third man where the fielder makes a good dive to save the four
full ball outside off stump, Mahela leans into a cracking cover drive but can't beat the infield
too straight from Malinga, Mahela stays in his crease this time and flicks the ball deftly into the gap on the backward square leg boundary
Mahela skips out of his crease and towards leg, he then picks up the length ball and hoists it over midwicket, one-bounce four
that's short, that's wide, and there's no fielder at deep point to catch Sehwag's slash. He freed his arms and carved the ball over the infield
short of a length outside off, Mahela uses the angle and steers to third man
good length angling across Mahela who moves forward and defends towards point
short of a length on the hips, Sehwag chips the ball over square leg, there's a fielder in the deep and the ball reaches him on the bounce
RP gets the ball to move into Mahela after angling across him from over the wicket, the line is a bit straight and Mahela glances off his pads behind square
Mahela tries to whip the ball through square leg after coming out of his crease but misses and gets hit on the pad
it's like he was never away, Malinga ends a spot-on first over with a ball on a good length around middle stump, Sehwag pays it down on the leg side
this one came back into Sehwag, instead of moving away, Sehwag got behind the line and blocked
once again Sehwag is beaten, he stayed in his crease and pushed at a delivery that seamed away after pitching on off stump
good length on off stump again, 129 kph, Sehwag stays in his crease and punches to cover
Sehwag is squared up in his crease and beaten by a ball that rises from a good length and seams away late from off stump line
good length but the line is a touch straight on middle and leg, Mahela glances off his pads towards fine leg
bowled! The stumps are in disarray. Malinga backed away to a full ball and swung across the line. He missed.
the ball cuts into the right-hander and beats the bat, Naman dives to his left and makes the save
another full toss, hit towards long off

this has been caught but it's been called a no-ball for some reason. Was it for height? It wasn't above waist, that's for sure. The umpires check with the third umpire and the right decision has been made. It wasn't too high. Harbhajan had sliced the full toss towards point where Irfan judged the catch well
KP's dropped the catch at deep cover. Malinga slapped a full toss flat towards Pietersen, who came running in and then dropped it
Malinga backs away to try and hit a full ball from outside off stump through point, he gets beaten
he's slammed this, salvaging what he can for the net run rate. Harbhajan made room and hit the length ball flat over the extra cover boundary, or was it just short? It was just short
full again, Malinga backs away and hits it to long on
Harbhajan times the straight hit well but long-off is there to prevent the boundary, Morkel's keeping it full and straight
played towards deep point
in the blockhole once again, Malnga can only keep it out
in the blockhole on off stump, Harbhajan drives it to cover
not this time, though, Malinga moves towards leg and slaps the ball over extra cover for four
Malinga backs away and throws his bat at a full ball outside off, he gets beaten
driven past the bowler towards long on
full ball outside off, Harbhajan swings hard and bottom edges the ball into the ground and over the keeper's head for four
length ball, Harbhajan hits it hard and flat towards cover, Sehwag moves to his right to take the catch at waist height but drops it
Harbhajan throws his bat at a wide ball, but it is too far away to make contact
nearly in the blockhole, Harbhajan backs away and hits to long on
a full ball, hit towards long off
Malinga heaves at the ball, looking to hit a six down the ground, he missed and was nearly bowled
that's full and wide outside off, but just inside the tram line, Malinga had backed away towards leg, and the umpire's called it wide, a bit harsh in my opinion
a low full toss and Harbhajan pulls through midwicket
in the blockhole around off stump, squeezed out through point

Peterson backs away and swings a full ball in front of square, and there may be a run out here! The throw from Mahela on the boundary to the keeper was accurate and Peterson was caught short returning for the second. The umpire's called for TV replays but Peterson is already walking off
Harbhajan drives a full ball towards deep cover
Harbhajan moves across to a full toss and swats it through midwicket. Three runs and two wickets in the over. Nadeem has all but ended this game as a contest
a full toss and Peterson swings it through midwicket
Harbhajan drives a full ball towards long off
full and flat, driven hard but back to the bowler

bowled him! Nadeem has shut Mumbai out of this game. He bowled a full and quick ball from round the wicket, angling into Pollard. Pollard backed away towards leg to hit on the off side, he missed and was a goner. Pollard yorked himself

that's high over midwicket, has it gone far enough? No it hasn't, Mahela's on the boundary and he's taken the catch a couple of feet inside the rope. He looks behind to see whether the catch is clean, it is. Rayudu had slogged at the ball, lofting it from outside off stump over midwicket. He's timed most balls superbly tonight, but not that one
he backs away and cuts to the fielder at third man, 15 off this over
short of a length with width outside off, Rayudu waits and plays a wristy late cut to send the ball speeding wide of the fielder at third man
full toss outside off stump, Pollard mis-hits towards wide long-on, he was looking off side I thought
pulled again, not timed well though, but still gets two towards wide long on
short ball, and it has disappeared into the stands beyond the deep midwicket boundary. Pollard hit that 95 metres with an immense swivel pull, and he felt his shoulder after the shot
the short of a length slower ball, pulled to square leg from where Irfan hits the stumps direct at the bowler's end, the batsman was safe and they run an overthrow
Pollard backs away towards leg, Nadeem fires it outside off and beats the bat. Mumbai still haven't got as much as they need off this over
Pollard backs away and boy has he timed this well. He's hit it flat and hard, the ball pitched just inside the long-off boundary
Rayudu jumps down the pitch and drives between midwicket and mid-on
Pollard backs away once again and hits towards long off, again not timed well
Pollard backs away and slugs the ball through midwicket, not timed well
Nadeem fires the ball into the blockhole, Rayudu digs it out towards point
Agarkar's bowled a crucial over for Delhi, Pollard defends the last ball to the bowler. Mumbai needed 12 runs per over, this one has yielded only three.

bowled him! Karthik's missed a low full toss and his off stump has been uprooted. Accurate bowling from Agarkar, Karthik heaved across the line, aiming for midwicket, and once he missed the ball, it dipped and crashed into the base of off stump
the bouncer, and Karthik lets it go
Rayudu stays in his crease and flicks a full ball to Irfan at square leg, Irfan dives to stop the ball but then doesn't know where it is, he finds it eventually
short ball and Karthik is quick to get into position and pull, there's a fielder at deep midwicket to stop the boundary
length on the pads, glanced from the crease towards fine leg
played back to the bowler
in the blockhole around off stump, Rayudu plays towards point
nudged off the front foot through square leg
hit from the crease towards point
two in a row! Rayudu gets to his fifty by lofting the fuller ball cleanly over long off, terrific hitting from Rayudu, he did it against Punjab, can he do it tonight?
he starts with a long hop which Rayudu sends over the wide long-on boundary with a powerful pull
full ball on middle and leg, swung through square leg to the fielder in the deep
makes room to drive a good length delivery but but can't beat cover
good length just outside off and angling into the right-hander, Karthik mis-times the hit towards midwicket
a full toss around off stump, driven through cover and the batsmen rush between the wickets for two, Karthik had to dive but the throw to the keeper wasn't good
short ball once again and Karthik swivels and pulls with fantastic timing to the midwicket boundary
length ball outside off, square driven to deep cover
full ball on the pads, turned behind square
that's wide down leg side
another slower ball, this time it's a bit too short, Rayudu pulls with power through midwicket
Karthik takes two steps out and pulls, but the ball isn't short enough and goes off the top edge towards third man, that went very high in the air
the bouncer, slightly slower too, Rayudu stays in his crease and chips it towards third man
flicked off the pads toward fine leg
a short ball and Rayudu mis-times the pull to long on
played off the pads to short fine leg
fuller outside off stump, driven to deep cover
short ball and Karthik pulls it in the air and towards the midwicket boundary, one-bounce four. It was the slower ball and Karthik hit it while down on one knee
a low full toss outside off stump, Rayudu stays in his crease and drives to Nadeem on the cover boundary
short ball and Rayudu pulls, top-edging the ball over the keeper for four
length ball bowled full outside off, Rayudu launches it over the extra cover boundary ... looks like Sehwag wants to get Irfan's quota done with
a slower short of a length ball, played from the crease towards point, there's a throw at the bowler' end after the batsmen run a quick single. Agarkar's finished an excellent first over

there's a huge appeal for a caught behind, after a huge appeal for an lbw! Rayudu moved towards the off and tried to scoop the ball over the keeper, he missed and the ball lobbed off the pad to Naman Ojha
short of a length delivery and Rayudu pulls towards deep square leg
Rayudu backs away to play on the off but Agarkar follows him, he ends up pushing to cover
played on the leg side

good length and straight, Karthik moves forward to play and gets an inside edge on to the pad, the ball gets lodged in various parts of Karthik's body as he moves forward to run and it finally gets kicked (unintentionally) towards the leg side
makes room and punches a good length delivery to cover
a gift really, full-toss. Rayudu takes a step towards the line of the ball and lofts it over the infield to wide long-off for a boundary
fuller delivery outside the off stump. Karthik drives it to long-off for a single
drives it to sweeper cover for a single
fuller ball outside the off stump. Rayudu makes room and drives it to Sehwag at point. A poor fielding effort by the captain gifts him a couple
looks to drive, and is beaten by the away movement
comes forward and punches it to mid-off
short outside the off stump, in the circumstances the best ball to bowl. Karthik is a step ahead of the bowler. He stays rooted and cuts it ovet the point fielder for a boundary
another good length delivery. Karthik again moves inside the line of the delivery and flicks it past midwicket for a boundary
short ball on the off stump. Karthik looks to cut, and is beaten
the combination of Karthik and Rayudu is difficult to bowl to. Karthik walks into the line of the delivery and flicks it past midwicket for a boundary
Umesh Yadav begins his spell with a short of a good length delivery outside the off stump. Rayudu moves across and runs it down to third-man for a single
comes forward and defends it to the off side
comes forward and pushes it to mid-on for a single
well he seems to be learning a few strokes from Sachin Tendulkar. Rayudu makes room to a delivery pitched on the middle stump and smashes it past cover for a superb boundary
short ball outside the off stump. Rayudu looks to upper cut it and is beaten by the bounce
short ball outside the off stump. Karthik moves across and runs it to down to third-man for a single
fuller ball outside the off stump. He comes forward and drives it to  the cover fielder
turns it to fine-leg for a single

good length ball on the middle stump. Karthik leans forward and flicks this past the midwicket fielder for a boundary. It is to Karthik's advantage that he is getting these loose deliveries. He seems to gotten into the run-making form right away
that's a gift without a fine-leg fielder. Karthik helps it on its way and gets his first boundary
punches it to mid-off for a single
short ball outside the off stump. Rayudu was walking into the pull stroke and weaves away at the last moment. Umpire calls it a wide for the height
short ball outside the off stump. Rayudu moves across and cuts it to the point fielder

fuller ball on the middle stump. Rohit leans forward and looks to chip it over mid-on. He falls over and mistimes the chip. As soon as he played the stroke, he knew he was in trouble. He knelt down and saw Agarkar complete the catch at mid-on

short ball outside the off stump. Karthik moves across, and waits for it till the last moment. He plays it down with soft hands and wants a single. Rohit will have nothing to do with the call and doesn't move an inch
fuller ball once again, this time on the off and middle line. Karthik comes forward and punches it to mid-on
comes forward to a fuller ball on the off stump. He looks to drive and gets an inside edge to mid-on

he's holed out to mid-off! Tendulkar tried to blast the ball down the ground, the length was not full enough for the shot, the ball hit high on the bat and lobbed gently to the fielder, KP took an easy catch
Tendulkar makes room and tries to hit on the off side, mis-times the drive to mid-on
he loses balance on his follow through and hits the pitch, Rohit steers the short of a length ball to third man
pushed back to the bowler
inside out over cover and all the way for six! Tendulkar made room by moving towards leg and freed his arms while lofting the ball with superb timing
punched off the back foot towards cover
uses the angle into him to nudge off his pads behind square
Tendulkar tries to drive on the off side but plays it to the bowler again
Tendulkar comes out of his crease but ends up playing back to the bowler
in the air but over the leaping fielder at extra cover! Rohit uses the width outside off to free his arms and drive with power
defended on the front foot on the off side
that is some way to get going! Rohit simply flicks the ball high over deep square leg, perfect balance and timing
caught at cover! Irfan bowled a full ball and swung it away from the left-hander just a little, Blizzard looked to play straight towards mid-on and got a thick outside edge to Mahela
driven from the crease towards point, he can't afford too many more scoreless deliveries
good length outside off stump, Blizzard stays in his crease and mis-times the ball to cover
